metadata.title: chore: remove redundant linters, fix coverage output, update roadmap
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- Remove `importchecker` and `unimport` from Makefile, pyproject.toml, and CI lint workflow — redundant with ruff/flake8 F401 rule
- Change `make coverage` pytest flag from `-rA` to `-rfE` to suppress log capture noise from passing tests
- Mark 33 closed issues in `docs/docs/architecture/roadmap.md` (⏳ → ✅)
- Fix pr-review skill to select exactly one recommendation instead of listing all three
- Align e2e test JWT secret default with docker-compose.yml
- Add `--admin` flag to `register_fast_test` JWT token generation
- Update lock files (uv.lock, package-lock.json)

Closes #1290

## Test plan
- [ ] `make lint` passes without importchecker/unimport references
- [ ] `make coverage` no longer dumps captured logs for passing tests
- [ ] CI lint workflow runs without the removed unimport step
- [ ] E2e tests use correct JWT secret matching docker-compose default

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: This PR removes `unimport` (and `importchecker`) from the main repo’s lint targets, but the external plugin cookiecutter template still includes `unimport>=1.2.1` in its `dev` extras (`plugin_templates/external/{{cookiecutter.plugin_slug}}/pyproject.toml`). That will keep generating new plugins that rely on a tool the repo no longer supports. Consider updating the template (and any related docs) to match the new lint toolchain.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: `mcp-cli` and `tornado` are added to the `dev` dependency group here, but they are not imported anywhere in the Python codebase (mcp-cli is invoked as an external command; tornado appears only in docs/gunicorn config comments). Since this repo uses `tool.fawltydeps.ignore_unused` to silence expected “unused” dev tooling, consider adding `mcp-cli` and `tornado` there as well to avoid new `fawltydeps` noise.
